subject.title: [Feature]: System agent overhaul: shared chat UI, config change journal, durable history, agentic identity

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this five-phase system-agent program as core roadmap work, beginning with an owner-approved design for the shared presentation and durable redacted state boundaries?
rationale: The proposal creates new durable state, gateway/API surface, operator audit behavior, and cross-client UI behavior; code review cannot safely choose the permanent product and ownership boundaries without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor a phased core design
options.body: Approve an owner-led design and split the work into independently reviewable phases, starting with explicit persistence, redaction, retention, and rescue-path contracts.

options.title: Narrow to a single foundation phase
options.body: Authorize only the highest-value bounded phase, such as shared custodian presentation or a read-only config journal design, before committing to durable transcript and model-driven identity work.

options.title: Defer core work
options.body: Leave the request open as a roadmap discussion until a maintainer can fund and own the cross-surface product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a phased core design
recommendation.body: Approve an owner-led design and split the work into independently reviewable phases, starting with explicit persistence, redaction, retention, and rescue-path contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies steipete as the author of the concrete architecture proposal; repository history was not available to establish a stronger area owner.
